prompt: Create an original 60 second Middle Eastern acoustic instrumental instrumental composition for celebration, positive conclusion and project reveal. Mood: hopeful, joyful, uplifting. Instruments: oud, qanun, darbuka. Style: ornamented modal melody with rolling hand-drum rhythm. Tempo approximately 110 BPM; C major. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Introduce a memorable rising motif, develop it, and end with a confident resolved cadence. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A lively and upbeat folk-inspired instrumental piece featuring a prominent accordion melody, supported by a rhythmic acoustic guitar, bass, and light percussion. It has a cheerful and danceable feel.
description.zh: 一首活泼欢快的民谣风格器乐曲，以手风琴为主旋律，由节奏感强的原声吉他、贝斯和轻柔的打击乐器伴奏。整体感觉欢快且富有舞动感。
